abdn_home_b_dad.text: Binfoxes come out on bin day with fur bristling and plans in their eyes. Never leave a bag out. They know.
The haarling comes in with the haar, the cold sea fog off the North Sea. It always arrives on the day of the picnic.

then.text: Another bit? You will be too sweet to stand. Off you go.

else.text: Here, take a bit of tablet. My wife makes it by the tray and I am only allowed to give it away.
